summaries.en: The United States warned it would sanction any entity paying transit fees to Iran for passage through the Strait of Hormuz, while continuing its naval blockade until a final peace agreement is reached.
summaries.zh: 美国警告称，将制裁任何为通过霍尔木兹海峡而向伊朗支付过路费的实体，并表示将继续实施海上封锁，直至达成最终和平协议。
